title: Help Center
description: Find key workflows, feature guidance, and quick navigation entry points.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.intro: Start by configuring connections, team roles, and ticket workflows before enabling inspections, approvals, and deployments.
quickStart.step1: Configure a local or remote OpenClaw connection in Connection Settings.
quickStart.step2: Set up roles, agents, and minimum-permission tool access in Team Management.
quickStart.step3: Use the Ticket Board to process requests and record deliverables.
quickStart.step4: Enable approvals, doctor checks, deployments, and activity tracing as needed.

tickets.title: Ticket Management
tickets.intro: Tickets capture the full lifecycle from intake to delivery and serve as the main collaboration container.

statusFlow.title: Status Flow
statusFlow.description: Tickets move through INBOX → SPEC → DEV → TEST → DELIVERY → DONE.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.description: Store plans, code changes, tests, deployment notes, and rollback instructions under each ticket.

team.title: Team Management
team.intro: Manage roles, agents, tools, and the authorization matrix while keeping least-privilege boundaries intact.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Roles define default prompts, output schemas, and risk levels for downstream agent behavior.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Agents are bound to roles, models, and runtimes, and can be enabled or disabled individually.

tools.title: Tool Access
tools.description: Use the authorization matrix to grant only the tools each agent actually needs.

approvals.title: Approval Workflow
approvals.intro: High-risk actions require explicit approval before execution continues.

highRisk.title: High-Risk Actions
highRisk.description: This includes outbound sending, production deployments, config changes, exports, and token rotation.

workflow.title: Execution Flow
workflow.description: The system creates an approval record first, then proceeds with execution and auditing only after approval.

config.title: Config Center
config.intro: Manage OpenClaw configuration centrally with diff review, approvals, and rollback support.

models.title: Models & Routing
models.description: Configure default models, fallbacks, allowlists, and role-specific overrides.

security.title: Security Settings
security.description: Sensitive fields should stay in the keychain, with special attention to proxies, hooks, and auth policies.

deployments.title: Deployment Management
deployments.intro: Manage the OpenClaw lifecycle across local and remote environments from one place.

modes.title: Deployment Modes
modes.description: Supports local native, local Docker, remote native, and remote Docker targets.

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: Run prechecks, health checks, start, stop, restart, upgrade, and log inspection workflows.

q1.question: How do I connect to OpenClaw?
q1.answer: Open Connection Settings and fill in the endpoint, auth mode, and credentials for a local or remote profile.

q2.question: How do I create a ticket?
q2.answer: Create a new ticket from the Ticket Board and keep requirements, plans, and deliverables updated as it moves forward.

q3.question: Why do some actions require approval?
q3.answer: Outbound communication, production changes, and other risky operations are intentionally gated for safety.

q4.question: How do I troubleshoot a failed deployment?
q4.answer: Start with deployment details, activity feed, alerts, and doctor results, then follow the related trace chain.

q5.question: How can I inspect the full event chain?
q5.answer: Use Activity Feed or Trace Detail to follow operations, alerts, jobs, and related objects by trace_id.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.close: Close the current dialog or overlay
